description: This file defines the IDGeneratorService class, which provides functionality for generating and managing unique identifiers for various entities within the OrangeHRM system, such as locations, job categories, job titles, memberships, and employees. It includes methods for retrieving the next ID, updating IDs, and prefixing IDs according to entity types.

classes.name: IDGeneratorService
classes.description: A service class for generating and managing unique IDs for various entities in the system, with support for prefixing based on entity type.

methods.name: getIDGeneratorDao
methods.description: Retrieves the DAO responsible for ID generation, instantiating it lazily if necessary.

methods.name: setIDGeneratorDao
methods.description: Sets the IDGeneratorDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: getEntityPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string associated with a given entity class.

methods.name: getNextID
methods.description: Generates the next available ID for a specified entity class, optionally updating the stored ID.

methods.name: incrementId
methods.description: Increments the current ID counter for a specified entity class.
